below. Feel free to read a white paper on a project highlighting the advantage. Also, see more on
each advantage on our [The Shelter Structures Advantage page.][101]

**Custom Designed: **[Comtech Industries Project][102]

**Heavier, Stronger Frames**: [DLA Distribution–Robins AFB Project][103]

**No ground rails to create trip hazards**: [White Rock Quarries Project][104]

**Stronger connections**: [CAF Large Fabric Structure Project][105]

**Corrosion Protection**: [RES/BP Wind Energy Project][106]

**Longer fabric life**: [Naval Air Station Military Hangars][107]

**Ease of Installation**: [Cannon AFB Project ][108]

**Top Quality Fabric: **[Port-au-Prince Post Office Project][109]

## Commercial Sun Shade SAILS & Structures

At Advanced Shade Systems we provide builders, architects, commercial businesses and local
governments with functional and effective sun shade and waterproof membranes that meet and exceed
their expectations.

We offer a wide range of standard and customised products ranging from wholesale shade sails and
permanent waterproof umbrellas, to purpose built shade sails and structures, car park structures and
more innovative products. Our success is not only attributed to the top quality products that we
offer, but also the personalised and dedicated service that we offer our clients, many of whom
return to us whenever they need to discuss a new shade requirement. The team at Advanced Shade
Systems will work with you from the design stage through to engineering, building approval,
installation and final inspection.

Unlike some other shade companies, we handle the entire process in-house, from design, fabrication,
installation to certification. We have all of our own equipment which we can pass on to our
customers in savings, plus gives our team a far greater insight and experience in the industry,
which is very important considering the intricate nature of shade.

Our website features just a small selection of the projects, products and services that we have been
involved with in the last 20+ years working in the shade industry. Contact us today to discuss a
shade solution that can be customized to your specific needs.

promoting tensile architecture worldwide. AMA represents industrial companies, professionals, and
stakeholders actively engaged in tensile architectural membrane design, engineering, manufacturing,
and installation. Through advocacy, knowledge sharing, and international collaboration, AMA supports
innovation, best practices, and the global development of tensile membrane structures.

Ambient Enterprises is a leading **Tensile Structure Manufacturer in Delhi**, offering innovative,
durable, and aesthetically appealing tensile roofing solutions for commercial, industrial,
residential, and architectural applications. With years of expertise in the tensile industry, we

cost-effective, durable, and visually impressive tensile structures that enhance outdoor spaces
across Delhi NCR and throughout India.

# Membrane Systems Europe B.V.

Membrane Systems Europe B.V. (MSE) is specialized in the production and installation of covering
systems for the international biogas market. The stakeholders of MSE have a combined experience over
100 years in the biogas market with installations worldwide.

Our sales agents and employees share the goal of ensuring that our clients are satisfied with the
information provided during the offer stage. They are committed to working closely with customers to
build trust and comfort with our organization. We also maintain contact post installation to make
certain that the client is absolutely satisfied with the service we provided.

[More information][27]

## Why we can help you!

MSE roofing systems are subject to static calculations according to Eurocode 1 (Germany DIN 1055)
specifications. Products comply to the highest European standard tolerances including snowload and
windload. [Biogas domes][28], [double membrane covers][29], and high-point-membranes are all 100%
high-frequency welded. With clients increasingly requiring more size and pressures from gas storage
roofs, this method of welding provides increased strength and extended lifespan.  Our products can
also tolerate pressures up to 40 mBar and diameters up to 50 meters.

As a total system supplier of covers, gas pressure management and mixing systems and specialist in
this field, we can advise you on the best solution to meet your specific needs.

**Are you ready for an inspiring meeting?**

The single membrane cover structure is constructed from heavy polyester textile with a synthetic
coating material on both sides to reduce emissions.

# Membrane Systems Europe B.V.

Membrane Systems Europe B.V. (MSE) is specialized in the production and installation of covering
systems for the international biogas market. The stakeholders of MSE have a combined experience over
100 years in the biogas market with installations worldwide.

Our sales agents and employees share the goal of ensuring that our clients are satisfied with the
information provided during the offer stage. They are committed to working closely with customers to
build trust and comfort with our organization. We also maintain contact post installation to make
certain that the client is absolutely satisfied with the service we provided.

## Why we can help you!

MSE roofing systems are subject to static calculations according to Eurocode 1 (Germany DIN 1055)
specifications. Products comply to the highest European standard tolerances including snowload and
windload. [Biogas domes][28], [double membrane covers][29], and high-point-membranes are all 100%
high-frequency welded. With clients increasingly requiring more size and pressures from gas storage
roofs, this method of welding provides increased strength and extended lifespan.  Our products can
also tolerate pressures up to 40 mBar and diameters up to 50 meters.

As a total system supplier of covers, gas pressure management and mixing systems and specialist in
this field, we can advise you on the best solution to meet your specific needs.

### Mastering the Elements

A portfolio of innovative corrosion-prevention solutions that increase readiness, decrease
maintenance costs, and extend useful life.

[ Learn more ][17]
[ Our Solutions ][18]
 
 
 

# Corrosion is the cause of 1.15m Non-Available Days annually.

# **We can help you lower that number**.

Cocoon products are specifically designed to protect critical assets from the elements and
prevent/mitigate corrosion in order to increase equipment readiness, lower maintenance costs, and
extended lifecycles.

# **Cocoon uses science & engineering to outsmart Mother Nature.**

### Protective Covers

Utilizing advanced technical textiles, Cocoon has set a new standard in cover performance.

[ Learn more ][19]
 

### Aviation Insulation

Cocoon hasn’t just modernized aviation insulation, we’ve revolutionized it.

[ Learn more ][20]
 

### Fabric Structures

Building-code-compliant, these durable structures serve as hangars, warehouses and more.

[ Learn more ][21]
 

### Environments

Our Corrosion-Free Environments stop the aging process, making them ideal for storage of high-value
assets.

[ Learn more ][22]
 
 
 

# **Increase your readiness while reducing your maintenance costs.**

In just one study, the DoD Corrosion Policy Office found the average estimated return-on-investment
for corrosion mitigation projects was 50:1.

(GAO-11-318SP)

[ Contact Cocoon ][23]

# Home

# International Tension Structures is a US-based specialty contractor of custom tensile membrane
# structures.

Our tensile membrane structures include moving and dramatic light-filled forms which are engineered
and constructed using a high-tech blend of structural and architectural steel and bold curving
fabric membrane panels. Whether it be for form, function or both, ITS is committed to developing
project-specific solutions that deliver extraordinary results for our clients.

Our approach to designing and building tensioned fabric structures is turn-key and blends cutting
edge technology with real world construction know-how. Our professional services include design,
engineering, fabrication and installation of custom & unique tensile structures. Our structures are
efficient, environmentally sustainable and provide solutions to UV and weather protection on
buildings and outdoor spaces which have long-lasting performance as well as innovative and inspiring
architectural forms.

We invite you to browse our website and review some of our selected projects. If you have a question
or a need, please contact ITS and allow us to demonstrate how our fabric architecture can benefit
you.

## FABRIC GRAPHICS…

Have you considered using graphics & print imagery on your fabric?

This can be an effective way to bring another level of art and aesthetics to your project.

Ask ITS about our Fabric Graphics services!

## RETRACTABLE STRUCTURES…

ITS offers a custom designed Retractable Structure for roofs, shade structures & other canopy
systems.

Like everything we do, the ITS Retractable Structures are custom designed and engineered for their
unique project and space.

Ask ITS about our Retractable Structures!

## DESIGN & ENGINEERING…

ITS provides professional design & engineering services to our clients.

From concept and design development to membrane selection, specifications, construction
documentation, engineering and structural analysis, ITS is here to support you.

Give ITS a call for assistance on your next tensioned fabric structure project.

# Home

# International Tension Structures is a US-based specialty contractor of custom tensile membrane
# structures.

Our tensile membrane structures include moving and dramatic light-filled forms which are engineered
and constructed using a high-tech blend of structural and architectural steel and bold curving
fabric membrane panels. Whether it be for form, function or both, ITS is committed to developing
project-specific solutions that deliver extraordinary results for our clients.

Our approach to designing and building tensioned fabric structures is turn-key and blends cutting
edge technology with real world construction know-how. Our professional services include design,
engineering, fabrication and installation of custom & unique tensile structures. Our structures are
efficient, environmentally sustainable and provide solutions to UV and weather protection on
buildings and outdoor spaces which have long-lasting performance as well as innovative and inspiring
architectural forms.

We invite you to browse our website and review some of our selected projects. If you have a question
or a need, please contact ITS and allow us to demonstrate how our fabric architecture can benefit
you.

This can be an effective way to bring another level of art and aesthetics to your project.

Ask ITS about our Fabric Graphics services!

ITS offers a custom designed Retractable Structure for roofs, shade structures & other canopy
systems.

Like everything we do, the ITS Retractable Structures are custom designed and engineered for their
unique project and space.

Ask ITS about our Retractable Structures!

## DESIGN & ENGINEERING…

ITS provides professional design & engineering services to our clients.

From concept and design development to membrane selection, specifications, construction
documentation, engineering and structural analysis, ITS is here to support you.

Give ITS a call for assistance on your next tensioned fabric structure project.

new technology and materials for improved aesthetics and durability.

## WORLDWIDE DIVERSITY IN
## **TENSILE MEMBRANE ARCHITECTURE**

**Span Flex** provides turn-key highly customized tensioned membrane structures, tensile facades,
frame supported and air-supported fabric-clad structures. With over 40 years of experience, Span
Flex’s in-house capabilities include [design][25], [engineering][26], [fabrication][27], and
[installation][28] solutions resulting in over **500 million ft²** of architectural membrane
structures globally.

Working closely with architects, engineers, general contractors and owner/developers, Span Flex
provides a diverse skill set and a collaborative service-driven management style to bring imagined
conceptual ideas to life. Creating custom [PTFE-coated fiberglass membrane][29], [PVC membrane][30],
and [ETFE film][31] innovative roofing systems, canopies and skylights, our work ranges from festive
amphitheaters, functional building facades, sporting venues, transportation terminals to
eye-catching retail centers. Span Flex is committed to delivering high-quality and state-of-the-art
signature designs to its customers.

## キービジュアルに込めた想い

[キービジュアル][キービジュアル]

### 砂漠に膜の人口山脈をつくる、
### そして雨を降らし、ひとつの街をつくる。

砂漠の中に造られた巨大な膜とひとつの街は、太陽グループが一丸となり、実現したい景色を描いています。
「街」はハードとソフトの掛け算から創られるもの。人々が、活き活きと暮らし、笑顔で包まれる街を、太陽工
業の建築のチカラ、TSPのイベントのチカラ、アクティオの施設運営のチカラを融合し、創っていきたい。企画
から定着まで、全てに並走することができる太陽グループだからこそ実現できる目標です。

「もう一度、豊かな未来を創りだせ」と。

これまでも、数多のチャレンジや前代未聞を、
チャンスや進化へと結びつけてきた
太陽グループのDNAが、
これまで以上に必要とされている。

企む、建てる、運ぶ、集める、拡げる、つなぐ。
モノづくりと価値づくりのスペシャリストである
太陽グループだからこそ、
全ての境界や限界を飛び越えて、

やわらかに考え、しなやかに実行し、

人と地球の可能性を最大限に拡張し、

## 太陽工業の事業

### 建築事業

建築に自由としなやかさを、産業に機能的で快適な空間をもたらす太陽工業の膜構造建築の製品と技術。暮らし
と社会、人と地球を明るく照らす魅力的な建築物を生み出します。

[建築事業について][47]

[


### 公共建築

スポーツ施設や庁舎、学校、福祉会館など、当社では多くの方々が利用する公共の建築物も数多く手がけていま
す。安全性の高い魅力的な建築物を実現します。

][48]
[


### 民間建築

国内外、規模や種類を問わず民間建築の豊富な実績があります。膜構造建築物のさらなる進化を追求しながら、
課題を解決し、お客様の想い描く建築物の実現に貢献します。

][49]
[


### 産業施設

テント倉庫で、機能性と効率性を兼ね備えた無柱の作業空間をお客様にご提供。建設コストや工期などの課題を
解決します。

][50]


### 海外事業

世界7大陸で事業を展開。スタジアムや国際空港、博覧会場など、数多くの建築物を手がけてきました。独自の
膜の技術で、世界と人々をつないでいきます。

[海外事業について][51]


### 物流事業

業界のリーディングカンパニーとして、長年培った豊富な経験とノウハウを活かした「品質×サービス×サポート
」を提供します。

[物流事業について][52]


### 国土事業

培ってきた膜の技術を活かし、環境保全や防災減災などに役立つ高品質の製品、工法を数多く生み出しています
。安心・安全な暮らしを支え、大切な環境を守っていくために、さまざまな課題解決に向けて積極的に取り組ん
でいます。

## Project Service Process

From early drawing evaluation to fabrication and installation guidance, we support overseas project
buyers with a clear and practical workflow.
* Project drawing review
  
  ###### Our engineers review your drawings, site dimensions and basic project requirements, then
  ###### provide practical suggestions for span, height, layout and material direction.
* Design and quotation
  
  ###### Based on the confirmed project information, we provide material options, structural
  ###### direction and a reference quotation for your evaluation.
* Fabrication drawings
  
  ###### We prepare and confirm fabrication drawings with the client before production, helping
  ###### reduce misunderstanding during manufacturing and installation.
* Controlled fabrication
  
  ###### Membrane cutting, steel structure processing and related fabrication steps are arranged
  ###### according to the approved drawings and project schedule.
* Export packing
  
  ###### Finished components are packed and loaded for export, with attention to protection,
  ###### labeling and container space arrangement.
* Installation guide
  
  ###### We can provide installation guidance based on project requirements, including drawing
  ###### explanation, assembly sequence and site coordination support.
